races.display_title: Crottys Lake Maiden Hurdle
races.verdict: DETROIT MAVERICK made a promising start in this sphere at Gowran and is narrowly preferred to World As One , who should also have races in him. Rond Point has shown promise in bumpers and could go well on his hurdling debut. DETROIT MAVERICK (IRE) WORLD AS ONE (GER) ROND POINT

races.display_title: Kilclooney Woods (Q.R.) Handicap Hurdle (0-100)
races.verdict: LAKE CHAD switches back to hurdles off a handy mark and looks likely to make a bold bid for a yard in good form at present. Dark Lieutenant has more ability than he's been able to show to date and is likely to prove the main danger, while Kelly's Cosmos is well treated if able to build on small promise of his last run. LAKE CHAD (IRE) DARK LIEUTENANT (IRE) KELLY'S COSMOS (IRE)

races.display_title: Clonmel Oil Chase Day November 5th Handicap Chase (0-100)
races.verdict: MOUNT SHENSHAN boasts excellent Clonmel form, including a handicap hurdle success here 3 weeks ago, and, racing off the same mark back over fences, she can follow up, with Wing Back feared most in first-time cheekpieces given he was a short-priced favourite last time and is clearly thought capable of better in this sphere, while Roccabaker and Shartheknowledge also appeal as potential improvers with just 3 chase starts between them. MOUNT SHENSHAN (IRE) WING BACK (IRE) ROCCABAKER (IRE) SHARETHEKNOWLEDGE (IRE)

races.verdict: MO OF CAIRO has shaped as if ahead of his mark in defeat on his last couple of outings and Kevin Ryan's colt is fancied to make a successful journey from the North. The Quiet Gent has to be respected on the back of his Salisbury win, with the unexposed Space Party and Distant Rumble also on the shortlist. MO OF CAIRO THE QUIET GENT (IRE) SPACE PARTY (IRE)

races.verdict: GETAWAY MASTER is 2 lb lower than when successful over Drop Kick here last year, and he may be able to confirm that form with the benefit of a comeback run. Is She Now looks a danger over hurdles for first time since joining current yard, with Royal Rhythm and Fourofakind others to consider in an open race. races.verdict: GOLDEN ACE has had valid excuses when falling short on reappearance the previous 2 seasons and her class may prevail this time. Burdett Road chased home Jeremy Scott's mare twice last season, and while better off at the weights this time, he hasn't been in top form on the Flat more recently. Wilful went from strength to strength last year and could have a say if picking up where he left off. GOLDEN ACE BURDETT ROAD WILFUL (IRE)
